exam: 2022年12月 第2套 · 仔细阅读 P1
title: We're eating more fish than ever these days.…

sents.en: We're eating more fish than ever these days.
sents.cn: 如今我们吃的鱼比以往任何时候都多。

sents.en: At around 20 kilograms per person global fish consumption is now more than twice what it was in the 1960s.
sents.cn: 全球人均鱼类消费约为20公斤，已是20世纪60年代的两倍多。

sents.en: What's really remarkable, though, is where that fish comes from.
sents.cn: 然而真正引人注目的是，这些鱼来自哪里。

sents.en: For the first time in human history, most of our aquatic (水产的) food now comes from farming rather than fishing.
sents.cn: 人类历史上第一次，我们的大部分水产品如今来自养殖而非捕捞。

sents.en: People ate around 73 million tonnes of farmed fish·just more than half of the volume of fish that humans consumed·in 2014.
sents.cn: 2014年，人们吃掉了约7,300万吨养殖鱼——略高于人类鱼类消费总量的一半。

sents.en: That's out of a total fish supply of 167 million tonnes; the remaining 20 million or so tonnes go into things like animal feed and medical products.
sents.cn: 这一数字出自1.67亿吨的鱼类总供应；其余约2,000万吨则用于动物饲料和医药产品等。

sents.en: To keep eating fish at the current rate, we're definitely going to need to keep aquaculture (水产养殖) developing.
sents.cn: 要按目前的速度继续吃鱼，我们肯定需要让水产养殖持续发展。

sents.en: That's because the volume of fish caught in the wild has leveled off since the 1990s.
sents.cn: 这是因为自20世纪90年代以来，野生捕捞量已趋于停滞。

sents.en: Back in 1974, only 10% of marine fish stocks had been overfished.
sents.cn: 早在1974年，只有10%的海洋鱼类资源被过度捕捞。

sents.en: Now, more than three-tenths are.
sents.cn: 如今，这一比例已超过十分之三。

sents.en: Only a tenth of our oceans' fish stocks could sustain heavier fishing than current levels.
sents.cn: 全球海洋鱼类资源中，只有十分之一还能承受比当前水平更高的捕捞强度。

sents.en: But while catching at sea has suffered, fish-farming has been growing at a fast rate.
sents.cn: 海上捕捞日渐衰落的同时，鱼类养殖却在快速增长。

sents.en: A lot of that is coming from China, which produces 60% of the world's farmed fish.
sents.cn: 其中很大一部分来自中国——它生产了全球60%的养殖鱼。

sents.en: In fact, some 35 countries, including China, now produce more farmed than wild-caught fish.
sents.cn: 事实上，包括中国在内，如今约有35个国家的养殖鱼产量已超过野生捕捞量。

sents.en: This shift toward aquaculture isn't just good for ensuring salmon (三文鱼) on your plate; it's also crucial to ensuring food security and sustainability.
sents.cn: 向水产养殖的转变，不仅有助于确保你餐桌上的三文鱼，对保障粮食安全与可持续性也至关重要。

sents.en: By 2050, the world will need to feed an estimated 9.7 billion people. They'll have to get their protein somewhere.
sents.cn: 到2050年，世界将需要养活预计97亿人口，他们必须从某处获取蛋白质。

sents.en: However, raising cattle, pigs, and other land-based animals requires vast sums of grain and water.
sents.cn: 然而，饲养牛、猪等陆生动物需要消耗大量谷物和水。

sents.en: For example, pound for pound, beef requires 15 times more feed to raise than carp, a freshwater fish farmed all over Asia.
sents.cn: 例如，等重计算，饲养牛肉所需的饲料是鲤鱼——一种在亚洲各地广泛养殖的淡水鱼——的15倍。

sents.en: That grain·and the water needed to grow it·could be consumed by people instead.
sents.cn: 那些谷物，以及种植谷物所需的水，本可以由人来消费。

sents.en: However, aquaculture is no silver bullet.
sents.cn: 然而，水产养殖并非灵丹妙药。

sents.en: In some southeast Asian countries, shrimp farming does disastrous damage to marine ecosystems.
sents.cn: 在一些东南亚国家，养虾对海洋生态系统造成毁灭性破坏。

sents.en: Despite these problems, however, shrimp continues to be among the most popular seafoods worldwide.
sents.cn: 尽管存在这些问题，虾依然是全球最受欢迎的海鲜之一。
